pins.name: steamd
pins.text: Material 3 / Material You theme for the Steam Android app. An Android app that patches Steam on your phone: wallpaper colours, Google Sans, Material icons, rounded UI and a restyled store, all signed and installed on the device.

pins.name: Telegram-CLI
pins.text: a full-featured and blazing fast telegram client for linux terminals, built from scratch in c++20 with tdlib and ftxui. features multi-theme support, realtime messaging, full keyboard-driven navigation, and custom user badges via exteraGram api integration.

pins.name: OkakOS
